title: "Turbo Encabulator" the Original
summary: The earliest filmed version of the Turbo Encabulator technical-jargon parody, shot in the late 1970s with narrator Bud Haggert. It deadpans a stream of meaningless engineering language.
why: Used as the canonical reference for the jargon-parody trope, and as a joke whenever technobabble appears.

quote.text: Doug Zongker's presentation similarly instructs people how to make better presentations to peers by demonstrating what not to do
